semiconductor_relevance: High — Woosung E&D provides specialized equipment and solutions directly used in semiconductor fabs and foundries.
summary: Woosung E&D specializes in engineering high-performance solutions for semiconductor fabs and foundries. Their offerings include high-speed gate valves, hot nitrogen systems, heated exhaust components, and sensors for process monitoring, all designed to enhance production efficiency and reliability.
capabilities: High-speed gate valves with sub-0.9 second close times
Hot nitrogen and nitrogen dilution systems for thermal control
Sensors and metrology tools for process monitoring
